title: U.S. House · South Carolina's 2nd District

context.text: Incumbent Joe Wilson (R) won renomination in the June 9, 2026 Republican primary with 74.2% of the vote.
Zyon Khalifa won the Democratic primary runoff on June 23, 2026 with 53.8% of the vote, defeating David Robinson II.

priorities.text: Expanding economic opportunity, supporting small businesses and workforce development, and improving infrastructure so families do not have to leave the district to succeed.
Improving healthcare access and affordability, especially in underserved areas.
Advancing data privacy protections and criminal justice reform focused on both public safety and rehabilitation.

positions.summary: His campaign platform calls for a minimum wage increase so full-time workers can achieve financial stability.
positions.quote: Implement a minimum wage increase so that full-time workers can achieve financial stability and support their families.

positions.summary: His campaign platform calls for policies promoting solar, wind and other renewable energy and for legislation aiming at net-zero emissions.
positions.quote: Advocating for policies that promote solar, wind, and other renewable energy sources to reduce carbon emissions.

statements.quote: Prioritize enforcement on serious public safety threats, not families and workers contributing to our communities
